name: BUG-8838
description: A session cookie captured before logout must be rejected by the server after logout
descriptionHtml: A session cookie captured before logout must be rejected by the server after logout
statusMessage: BUG-8838: a session cookie captured before logout STILL authenticates afterwards (/api/auth/me HTTP 200 isLoggedIn=true). Logging out cleared only the browser's view of the session; the server did not revoke it, so anyone holding the captured cookie stays authenticated after the user signs out. expected [false] but found [true]
